summary: Slide authored rectangular blocks along constrained axes toward a visible exit.
objective: Build an authored sliding-block escape puzzle with axis-constrained moves, undo and a visible goal exit.
intent_signals: slide a block to an exit
example_prompts: Build an authored sliding-block escape puzzle with axis-constrained moves, undo and a visible goal exit.
Show all legal displacements for the selected block without moving other pieces.

entities.name: Board and exit
entities.guidance: Build shallow board walls with one explicit goal opening; align grid and block footprints.

entities.name: Blocks
entities.guidance: Create rectangular prisms with stable IDs and direction engravings.

object_craft.structure: Build shallow board walls with one explicit goal opening; align grid and block footprints.
object_craft.material: Matte tray with contrasting exit trim.

object_craft.structure: Create rectangular prisms with stable IDs and direction engravings.
object_craft.material: Smooth colored wood-looking finish; small visual gaps do not alter occupancy.

state_contract.model: Integer grid occupancy, immutable block dimensions, one allowed movement axis per block, goal block and exit rule; no rotations.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Select block and preview legal travel.

invariants: Swept cells across the whole move are empty; empty destination alone is insufficient.
Only the goal block may leave through the designated opening.
Undo restores block poses and move count without rounding drift.
motion_guidance: Tween accepted grid displacement with input locked or queued until commit completes.
Reject perpendicular dragging with axis feedback.
known_limits: Puzzle rules and layout are authored, not a claim about a named commercial puzzle.
Do not advertise shortest solution without an actual exhaustive or appropriately proven search.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Shallow walls and engraved axes make legal movement visible even before interaction.

colliders: Swept grid occupancy and board bounds.
contact: Discrete rule rejection, not friction or pushing dynamics.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Reject jump over occupied intermediate cells; undo restores move count.
